exposure: NO(2) exposure during the last trimester of pregnancy
CO exposure during the last 10 d of pregnancy
cohort: 3614 women born in Italy, living in Lombardia Region, who underwent elective cesarean section between 2004 and 2006
finding: Exposure to CO during the last 10 days of pregnancy was positively associated with birth weight, while NO(2) exposure during the last trimester was associated with reduced placental weight.
